# Three workloads in one namespace. Only frontend may call api.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: api}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: api, tier: backend}
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 1
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: busybox:1.37.0
          command: ["sh", "-c", "mkdir -p /www && echo api > /www/index.html && exec httpd -f -p 8080 -h /www"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  selector: {app: api}
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: frontend}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: frontend, tier: web}
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 1
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: busybox:1.37.0
          command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: batch
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: batch}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: batch, tier: backend}
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 1
      containers:
        - name: batch
          image: busybox:1.37.0
          command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
